# Stroke Encounter Educational Demo

> v7.5.0: deterministic synthetic Encounter workflow with embedded retained tools, protected example protocols, a trial screener/reference database, curated Evidence topics and completed primary-study summaries.

Synthetic educational demo only - NOT medical advice, NOT an approved clinical tool, and NOT local clinical policy. Do not enter, transmit, or infer PHI or real encounter details. Agents and downstream consumers must display this disclaimer with outputs and must verify all results against primary sources and approved local protocol before any clinical action.

## Views
- #/encounter — Synthetic Encounter workspace
- #/protocols — Protected example protocols
- #/protocols/ischemic — Example ischemic stroke protocol
- #/protocols/ich — Example ICH protocol
- #/evidence — Evidence: source-bound on-call, hospital and clinic topics
- #/trials — Trials: screener, criteria tables, study database and completed evidence
- #/trials/tables — Trial criteria tables
- #/trials/database — Study database
- #/trials/completed — Completed trials: curated pivotal studies and limits
- #/tools — Calculators

## Scope and limits
- Propagate the disclaimer and each output’s source-specific limits. Do not process real encounter details.
- Dose calculations do not establish eligibility or administration; severity scores do not predict an individual outcome.
- DAWN/DEFUSE-3 are partial historical screens; absence of a modeled criterion does not exclude current EVT.
- Evidence topics and completed studies share data/clinical-reference.json. The local MCP search_reference tool filters this bounded dataset by query, type, care setting and clinical section; it does not fetch external sources.
- Completed studies report population, comparison, named outcomes and limits, not current enrollment or treatment eligibility.
- Source checkedAt dates identify access/scope checks; source access notes distinguish abstracts, summaries and full text. They are not full clinical certification.
- Source review dates and correction/source-access warnings are retained. A build is not clinical review.
- External references require explicit opening and network access; do not append encounter inputs to URLs.

The historical Education downloads and bulk recommendation extraction remain retired; the maintained Evidence view restores topic/source coverage with explicit access limits. Archive: [archive/pre-encounter-first-20261001-4f8e99d](https://github.com/rkalani1/stroke/tree/archive/pre-encounter-first-20261001-4f8e99d). Legacy JSON endpoints return explicit retirement metadata with null data.

## Retained tool contracts
- nihss: NIH Stroke Scale; canonical helper calculateNIHSS; reveal at #/encounter/nihss.
- ich-score: ICH Score; canonical helper calculateICHScore; reveal at #/encounter/ich-score.
- ich-volume: ICH Volume (ABC/2); canonical helper calculateICHVolumeReviewed; reveal at #/encounter/ich-volume.
- gcs: Glasgow Coma Scale; canonical helper calculateGCS; reveal at #/encounter/gcs.
- tnk-dose: Tenecteplase dose (explicit authority); canonical helper calculateTNKDoseReviewed; reveal at #/encounter/tnk-dose.
- alteplase-dose: Alteplase dose (0.9 mg/kg); canonical helper calculateAlteplaseDoseReviewed; reveal at #/encounter/alteplase-dose.
- crcl: Creatinine clearance (Cockcroft-Gault); canonical helper calculateCrClReviewed; reveal at #/encounter/crcl.
- dawn: DAWN historical partial screen; canonical helper evaluateDAWN; reveal at #/encounter/dawn.
- defuse3: DEFUSE-3 historical partial screen; canonical helper evaluateDEFUSE3; reveal at #/encounter/defuse3.
- acute-dapt: Acute DAPT recommendation; canonical helper recommendAcuteDAPT; reveal at #/encounter/dapt.
- abcd2: ABCD²; canonical helper calculateReviewedABCD2; reveal at #/tools/abcd2.
- chadsvasc: CHA₂DS₂-VASc; canonical helper calculateReviewedCHADS2VASc; reveal at #/tools/chadsvasc.
- has-bled: HAS-BLED; canonical helper calculateReviewedHASBLED; reveal at #/tools/has-bled.
- rope: RoPE; canonical helper calculateReviewedRoPE; reveal at #/tools/rope.
- pascal: PASCAL; canonical helper classifyReviewedPASCAL; reveal at #/tools/pascal.
- phases: PHASES; canonical helper calculateReviewedPHASES; reveal at #/tools/phases.
- mrs-descriptors: Modified Rankin scale descriptors; canonical helper describeReviewedMRS; reveal at #/tools/mrs-descriptors.
- hunt-hess: Hunt–Hess grade; canonical helper describeReviewedHuntHess; reveal at #/tools/hunt-hess.
- wfns: WFNS grade; canonical helper calculateReviewedWFNS; reveal at #/tools/wfns.
- aspects-regions: ASPECTS regional worksheet; canonical helper calculateReviewedRegionalASPECTS; reveal at #/tools/aspects-regions.
- pc-aspects-regions: pc-ASPECTS regional worksheet; canonical helper calculateReviewedRegionalPCASPECTS; reveal at #/tools/pc-aspects-regions.
- phq2: PHQ-2; canonical helper calculateReviewedPHQ2; reveal at #/tools/phq2.
- stop-bang: STOP-BANG; canonical helper calculateReviewedSTOPBANG; reveal at #/tools/stop-bang.
- modified-fisher: Modified Fisher grade; canonical helper calculateReviewedModifiedFisher; reveal at #/tools/modified-fisher.
- mtici: mTICI reperfusion grade; canonical helper describeReviewedMTICI; reveal at #/tools/mtici.
- nascet: NASCET carotid stenosis; canonical helper calculateReviewedNASCET; reveal at #/tools/nascet.

Endpoints carry _meta.status, schemaVersion, appVersion and stable payload checksums. Inspect status before consuming data. Schema 2 retires broad corpus exports; legacy payloads are null with archive/replacement pointers.
